edges.reason: block.timestamp (now) is read by getTimeLeft to compute the remaining round time.
block.timestamp (now) is read by getCurrentRoundInfo to compute the round end time.
getTimeLeft writes round_[_rID].end into the round_ mapping.
getCurrentRoundInfo mutates round_[_rID].end and reads round_ fields.
getTimeLeft reads rID_ to index the round_ mapping.
getCurrentRoundInfo reads rID_ to index the round_ mapping.
rID_ is copied into the local variable _rID in getTimeLeft.
The local _rID is used by getTimeLeft to address round_.
block.timestamp is assigned to the local _now in getTimeLeft.
The local _now is used by getTimeLeft in the modulo timing arithmetic.
rID_ is copied into the local variable _rID in getCurrentRoundInfo.
The local _rID is used by getCurrentRoundInfo to address round_.
block.timestamp is assigned to the local _now in getCurrentRoundInfo.
The local _now is used by getCurrentRoundInfo to compute round end.
withdraw executes the external transfer call.
withdraw makes an external call that forwards the entire contract balance to a fixed address, enabling reentrancy on the sending contract.
withdraw has no access control, so any msg.sender can trigger it and drain the balance.
withdraw assigns the hardcoded recipient to the local variable aff.
The local aff address is the recipient of the unsafe external transfer call.
The _keys parameter is the input consumed by iWantXKeys.
User-controlled _keys is multiplied by a constant, a potential overflow site if SafeMath were bypassed.
iWantXKeys performs the multiplication operation on _keys.
buyXid is payable and its effects derive from the caller msg.sender.
buyXaddr is payable and its effects derive from the caller msg.sender.
buyXname is payable and its effects derive from the caller msg.sender.
reLoadXid is a public state-changing entry point reachable by any msg.sender.
reLoadXaddr is a public state-changing entry point reachable by any msg.sender.
reLoadXname is a public state-changing entry point reachable by any msg.sender.
registerNameXID is payable and driven by the caller msg.sender.
registerNameXaddr is payable and driven by the caller msg.sender.
registerNameXname is payable and driven by the caller msg.sender.
The _affCode parameter flows into buyXid.
The _team parameter flows into buyXid.
The _eth parameter flows into reLoadXid.
The _pID parameter is used by getPlayerVaults.
The _addr parameter is used by getPlayerInfoByAddress.
The _otherF3D parameter is accepted by setOtherFomo.
The _rID parameter is used by calcKeysReceived.
The _eth parameter is used by calcKeysReceived.
The a parameter is the first operand of SafeMath.mul.
The b parameter is the second operand of SafeMath.mul.
activate is publicly callable by any msg.sender and rewrites round state.
activate overwrites round_[1] with hardcoded values without any authorization check.
The local c receives the result of SafeMath.mul.
The local z is used inside the SafeMath.sqrt iteration.
The local y is the returned result of SafeMath.sqrt.
The local z accumulates the result inside the SafeMath.pwr loop.
SafeMath.sq delegates its computation to SafeMath.mul.
SafeMath.pwr repeatedly calls SafeMath.mul inside its loop.
SafeMath.sqrt calls SafeMath.add during its Newton iteration.
